فُوَيْتٌ One who follows his, or her, own opinion only, (M, O, K,) not consulting any one: (O:) applied alike to a man and to a woman: (M, O, K:) on the authority of Er-Riyáshee: pronounced by AZ with hemz. (O.) ―
-b2- See also فَوْتٌ [of which it is the dim.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
